evidence.why: JWT access token is persisted in cleartext AsyncStorage, not held in memory only as required for the non-refresh token to be exempt.
On web platform the refresh token is stored unencrypted in AsyncStorage/localStorage.
If Keychain fails, refresh token silently falls back to cleartext AsyncStorage storage.

controls_present: react-native-keychain used for refresh token on iOS/Android with WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY accessibility
other_classes_observed: Silent fallback to insecure storage on error without alerting caller
